instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to complete the conversion.
Compare the volume of the two water containers and select the bigger one.
Compare the length of the two animals and select the shorter one.
Compare the weight of the two trunks and select the heavier one.
Gigi the giraffe was 1.5 `metres` tall at birth and has grown up to be 5 `metres` tall. The zookeeper calculates that she has grown 15 `feet`. Work out whether they are correct.
instruction.sound: Gigi the giraffe was 1.5 metres tall at birth and has grown up to be 5 metres tall. The zookeeper calculates that she has grown 15 feet. Work out whether they are correct.

atoms.a: First, find the difference in height in metres.
Next, convert your answer into feet.

instruction.text: The zookeeper also measured Gigi’s weight at birth and her current adult weight. At birth, she weighed 60 `kilograms` and now weighs 2500 `pounds`. Convert Gigi’s weight at birth into pounds to work out the difference.
instruction.sound: The zookeeper also measured Gigi’s weight at birth and her current adult weight. At birth, she weighed 60 kilograms and now weighs 2500 pounds. Convert Gigi’s weight at birth into pounds to work out the difference.

atoms.a: First, convert Gigi’s weight at birth into pounds.
Next, subtract your answer from her current weight to find the difference in weight.

instruction.text: Gigi drinks 36 `litres` of water per day on average. Convert the amount of water she drinks into pints.
